title: DBD FIELD statements following the SEGM they describe, NAME= coded for a field an SSA names
shapes: HKEP HKEPDB2: SEGM NAME=KEEP / FIELD NAME=(KEEPKEY,SEQ,U),BYTES=8,START=1,TYPE=C; SEGM NAME=WALL / FIELD NAME=(WALLKEY,SEQ,U),...
asserts: HKEPDB2 keys one DBD fact, two SEGM facts and two FIELD facts (KEEPKEY of segment KEEP, WALLKEY of segment WALL; bytes 8, start 1), each FIELD attached to the SEGM before it.

citations.quote: FIELD statements must immediately follow the SEGM statement to which they are related.
The NAME parameter is required on the following types of fields:

notes: The page lists, under that sentence, the field types referenced by a segment search argument (SSA); KEEPKEY is the field HKEPFIND's SSA names (H-0120).
